description: Change an appointment's time, service, location, status or reminder type. Id and UtcDateTime are required (send the current time to keep it); include only the other fields you are changing. The client and practitioner cannot be changed, and a Confirmed appointment cannot go back to WaitingConfirmation. IntakeQ: PUT /appointments.

SendClientEmailNotification.description: Email the client about the change.

UtcDateTime.description: Start time as a UTC Unix timestamp in ms (required even if unchanged).

name: intakeq_update_appointment
title: Update or reschedule an appointment
